{
  "workflow": {
    "activities": [
      {
        "id": "A1",
        "name": "Receive Trigger to Begin Verification Test",
        "actor": "Engineer",
        "system": "Unknown – trigger source varies by situation",
        "inputs": ["Signal or request indicating test should begin"],
        "outputs": ["Confirmation that workflow is initiated"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A2",
        "name": "Prepare Verification Test",
        "actor": "Engineer",
        "system": "Unknown – tools may be used but are unspecified",
        "inputs": ["Trigger confirmation", "Test requirements or parameters (specifics unknown)"],
        "outputs": ["Prepared test setup ready for execution"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A3",
        "name": "Run Verification Test / Evaluation",
        "actor": "Engineer",
        "system": "Unknown – may involve external tools",
        "inputs": ["Prepared test setup"],
        "outputs": ["Raw test results"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A4",
        "name": "Check Test Results",
        "actor": "Engineer",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Raw test results"],
        "outputs": ["Assessment of whether results are acceptable or anomalous"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A5",
        "name": "Write Short Report",
        "actor": "Engineer",
        "system": "Unknown – report stored somewhere accessible",
        "inputs": ["Assessed test results"],
        "outputs": ["Completed report covering key findings"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A6",
        "name": "Investigate Anomalous Results",
        "actor": "Engineer",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Anomalous or unexpected test results"],
        "outputs": ["Investigation findings"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A7",
        "name": "Re-run Verification Test",
        "actor": "Engineer",
        "system": "Unknown – same tools as A3",
        "inputs": ["Investigation findings indicating re-test is needed"],
        "outputs": ["New raw test results"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A8",
        "name": "Share Findings with Related Parties",
        "actor": "Engineer",
        "system": "Unknown – communication channel varies",
        "inputs": ["Investigation findings or completed report"],
        "outputs": ["Findings communicated to relevant stakeholders"]
      }
    ],
    "decisions": [
      {
        "id": "D1",
        "condition": "Do the test results look wrong or unexpected based on engineer's judgment?",
        "branches": [
          "Results acceptable → proceed to Write Short Report (A5)",
          "Results anomalous → proceed to Investigate (A6)"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "D2",
        "condition": "After investigation, does the situation require re-running the test or only sharing findings?",
        "branches": [
          "Re-test needed → proceed to Re-run Verification Test (A7)",
          "No re-test needed → proceed to Share Findings (A8)"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "exceptions": [
      "Trigger source may be unavailable or ambiguous, delaying workflow initiation",
      "Preparation steps may fail if required tools are inaccessible",
      "Investigation may be inconclusive, leaving resolution path undefined",
      "Report storage location may be inaccessible or undefined at time of submission"
    ],
    "dependencies": [
      {"from": "A1", "to": "A2", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A2", "to": "A3", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A3", "to": "A4", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A4", "to": "D1", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D1", "to": "A5", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D1", "to": "A6", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A6", "to": "D2", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D2", "to": "A7", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D2", "to": "A8", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A7", "to": "A4", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A5", "to": "A8", "type": "control_flow"}
    ]
  },
  "automation_opportunities": [
    {
      "target": "A1 – Receive Trigger to Begin Verification Test",
      "rationale": "If triggers follow a pattern (e.g., schedule, upstream system event, or request form), automated detection and routing could eliminate manual monitoring for when to start.",
      "required_data": ["Defined trigger types and sources", "Integration with upstream systems or scheduling mechanism"],
      "constraints": ["Trigger source is currently unknown and varies; standardisation required before automation is feasible"],
      "confidence": "low"
    },
    {
      "target": "A3 – Run Verification Test / Evaluation",
      "rationale": "Test execution is a strong candidate for automation if the test environment and parameters can be codified; automated test runners are common in verification workflows.",
      "required_data": ["Test parameters and configuration", "Identity of tools or systems used for execution"],
      "constraints": ["Tools used are unspecified; automation feasibility depends on tool capabilities and API availability"],
      "confidence": "medium"
    },
    {
      "target": "D1 – Results acceptable or anomalous?",
      "rationale": "Automated result validation against defined thresholds could replace subjective judgment, improving consistency and speed.",
      "required_data": ["Explicit acceptance criteria or thresholds", "Structured result data from A3"],
      "constraints": ["Currently relies on engineer judgment with no documented criteria; thresholds must be defined before automation is possible"],
      "confidence": "low"
    },
    {
      "target": "A5 – Write Short Report",
      "rationale": "Report generation could be partially automated by populating a template with structured result data, reducing manual effort.",
      "required_data": ["Defined report template", "Structured test results and assessment outputs", "Target storage location"],
      "constraints": ["Report content requirements and storage destination are vague; template must be standardised first"],
      "confidence": "medium"
    },
    {
      "target": "A8 – Share Findings with Related Parties",
      "rationale": "Automated notification or distribution could be triggered upon report completion or investigation conclusion, ensuring consistent communication.",
      "required_data": ["Defined list of stakeholders", "Preferred communication channel(s)"],
      "constraints": ["Recipients and channels are currently undefined and situation-dependent; stakeholder registry needed"],
      "confidence": "low"
    }
  ],
  "remaining_gaps": [
    "The nature, source, and format of the workflow trigger (schedule, request, event) are unknown and vary by situation.",
    "The specific preparation steps in A2 are undefined, and which tools or systems are used during preparation is unspecified.",
    "No explicit acceptance criteria or thresholds exist for determining whether results are anomalous (D1 relies on subjective judgment).",
    "The steps involved in the investigation activity (A6) are not described in detail.",
    "It is unclear under what conditions a re-run is decided versus simply sharing findings after investigation (D2 logic is informal).",
    "The identities and roles of 'related people' who receive findings are not specified.",
    "The communication channel used to share findings (A8) is undefined and varies situationally.",
    "The required content and format of the short report are vague ('key findings in some form').",
    "The storage location or system where the report is submitted is unknown.",
    "Whether the workflow has a formal end state or close-out step after sharing is unclear."
  ]
}
